test_item_verbatim: · The Head Unit shall transmit current display status using RADIO_B2.TGW_CAMERA_DISP_STAT. a) The head unit shall transmit RADIO_B2.TGW_CAMERA_DISP_STAT = [DISP_DIGITAL_RVC_CAMERA] AND vehicleUpdate_1.TGW_CAMERA_DISP_STAT = [DISP_DIGITAL_RVC_CAMERA] when Digital RVC is configured and display is active.

tcs.tc_title: RADIO_B2 status = DISP_DIGITAL_RVC_CAMERA, check RADIO_B2.TGW_CAMERA_DISP_STAT and the LVDS status
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The HU is in the Full-Operation state
2. PROXI Rear_View_Camera = 1 (Present)
3. No camera image is displayed
4. A bus analyzer is connected to the LVDS link between the HU and the RVCM
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Send CAN: STATUS_CCAN4.ReverseGearSts = 1 (Inserted)
2. Read RADIO_B2.TGW_CAMERA_DISP_STAT and check that it is 1 (DISP_DIGITAL_RVC_CAMERA)
3. Read vehicleUpdate_1.TGW_CAMERA_DISP_STAT and check that it is DISP_DIGITAL_RVC_CAMERA
tcs.expected_result:
1. STATUS_CCAN4.ReverseGearSts = 1 (Inserted) is sent and the rear view camera image is displayed
2. RADIO_B2.TGW_CAMERA_DISP_STAT = 1 (DISP_DIGITAL_RVC_CAMERA) is sent
3. vehicleUpdate_1.TGW_CAMERA_DISP_STAT = DISP_DIGITAL_RVC_CAMERA is sent over LVDS
tcs.test_item:
· The Head Unit shall transmit current display status using RADIO_B2.TGW_CAMERA_DISP_STAT. a) The head unit shall transmit RADIO_B2.TGW_CAMERA_DISP_STAT = [DISP_DIGITAL_RVC_CAMERA] AND vehicleUpdate_1.TGW_CAMERA_DISP_STAT = [DISP_DIGITAL_RVC_CAMERA] when Digital RVC is configured and display is active.

(RADIO_B2 status = DISP_DIGITAL_RVC_CAMERA, check RADIO_B2.TGW_CAMERA_DISP_STAT and the LVDS status)

reasoning: 驗證目標為 `SYS-RA-VF551_V3-257` 之 `a)` 分支（Digital RVC 已組態且畫面啟用）。上半為摘句（§4.3.1）：原句 60 token 逾 50，刪另一分支之子句後為 33 token，為原句之保序子序列，主句（以 `RADIO_B2.TGW_CAMERA_DISP_STAT` 送現況）與本分支之條件／結果皆保留。**`RADIO_B2` 實測為 `BO_ 1282`**（P363 與 637MCA 兩本），其 `TGW_CAMERA_DISP_STAT` 之 `VAL_` 與 Atl-Hi 側同值域（`0 DISP_NON_CAMERA`／`1 DISP_DIGITAL_RVC_CAMERA`），CAN 側因而寫 `<raw> (<label>)`；依 **R-CAM15(a)**（V42／V33 於本驗證點無對應條文）本列承 637／2261／376 三平台。Atl-Hi 側之對應為 `TELEMATIC_FD_14`（`-080`／`-081`），訊息名與母體皆異，故拆列。LVDS 之 `vehicleUpdate_*`／`gridZoomRequest`／`PowerShutDownNotifcation` 非 CAN 訊號（四本 DBC 零命中），觀察以 bus analyzer 於 HU ↔ RVCM 之 LVDS 鏈路進行；**不造命令**（交付語料 17 本之 275 條 `$ ` 命令行中與 LVDS 相關者為 0，A-CA27 加註）。
